intro.zh: 五道口。高校围着的街上，有一间叫 D-22 的房间。
intro.en: Wudaokou. On a street ringed by colleges, a room called D-22.

intro.zh: 2012 年它关了门。名字没有一起关掉，还在人嘴里走。
intro.en: It closed in 2012. The name did not. It is still being passed around.

intro.zh: 在北大教书的 Michael，看见当时北京活跃的地下乐手，觉得这座城市正在变成世界要听见的地方。
intro.en: Michael, teaching at Peking University, saw how alive the underground was, and thought the city was turning into a place the world would have to hear.

intro.zh: 他想帮那些还在象牙塔里的音乐天才。于是有了 D-22。
intro.en: He wanted to help the talent still inside the ivory tower. So there was D-22.

intro.zh: 这里很快成了高校乐队的天堂。
intro.en: It quickly became a heaven for campus bands.

intro.zh: 刺猬的子健那时还在北航。他记得演完一定喝酒，喝到天亮。他们叫这「坐穿馆」：把馆坐穿，再换个地方继续。
intro.en: Zijian of Hedgehog was still at Beihang. After the show they drank until morning. They called it zuo chuan guan: sit the place through, then move on and keep drinking.

intro.zh: Carsick Cars、Snapline 从这里走出去。Carsick Cars 还为 Sonic Youth 暖过场。
intro.en: Carsick Cars and Snapline came out of this room. Carsick Cars opened for Sonic Youth.

intro.zh: 酒并不特别。特别的是这间紧的屋子，和它不肯过滤的声音。
intro.en: The drinks were nothing special. The tight room was. So was the sound it refused to filter.

recordShop.zh: 唱片店是翻音乐的房间。黑胶和 CD 立在格子里，抽出来，就能听。
recordShop.en: A record shop is a room for flipping through music. Vinyl and CDs stand in the bins. Pull one out, and you can listen.

recordShop.zh: 北京还有这样的店。独音唱片 2011 年开在鼓楼东大街，自己也做厂牌。痛仰、旅行团的片子从这里出去过。
recordShop.en: Beijing still has rooms like this. Duyin Records opened on Gulou East Street in 2011, and became a label. Miserable Faith and The Life Journey passed through here.

recordShop.zh: 福声更早。2002 年开在平安里，2018 年搬到冰窖口胡同。架子上是崔健、唐朝、黑豹，还有窦唯。
recordShop.en: Fusheng is older. It opened near Ping'anli in 2002 and moved to Bingjiaokou Hutong in 2018. The shelves keep Cui Jian, Tang Dynasty, Black Panther, and Dou Wei.

recordShop.zh: 你脚下这间，也是这种店。走两步看看。
recordShop.en: The room under your feet is that kind of shop. Take a couple of steps.

hutong.zh: 酒还在嗓子里。胡同到了。先走到那扇门前。
hutong.en: The drink is still in the throat. The hutong is here. Walk to the door first.

boss.zh: 吃了么您。着急去看演出？
boss.en: Eaten yet? Rushing off to the show?

boss.zh: 门口那帮人，演完没有不喝的。你先别走。
boss.en: The ones at the door, none of them leave a show sober. Don't go yet.

boss.zh: 身后。刚给你搁上的。走之前拿一下。
boss.en: Behind you. I just set it out. Take it before you leave.

wine.zh: 酒并不为了解渴。台上声音一大，人就需要一点东西把白天关掉。
wine.en: The drink is not for thirst. When the sound onstage gets big, people need something to switch the day off.

wine.zh: 尼采管这叫酒神。不是神话，是那一下边界松了，嗓子和身子一起往前冲。
wine.en: Nietzsche called it the Dionysian. Not the myth. The moment the edges loosen, and the voice and the body rush forward together.

wine.zh: 所以演出必喝酒。音量把情感放大，酒把放大按实，让它停在这间屋子里。
wine.en: So a show means drinking. Not for the crowd. The volume turns the feeling up. The drink holds it down, keeps it in the room.

wine.zh: D-22 也是这样。演完坐穿馆，喝到天亮。酒是那场噪声还没散的时候，留下的那一口。
wine.en: D-22 was the same. After the set they sat the place through, and drank until morning. The drink is the mouthful left while the noise is still in the room.

wine.zh: 拿上。酒杯。这是你会的第二件事。
wine.en: Take the glass. This is the second thing you know.

choice.zh: 噪声已经把情感放大了。这一口，你要它怎样？
choice.en: The noise has already turned the feeling up. This mouthful. What do you want it to do?

choices.note:
BGM：失真推高，鼓贴到耳朵上，旋律几乎被噪声盖住。
相机：手持抖得明显，视野在 58 和 66 之间慢慢呼吸，转向更灵。
后处理：光晕打开，对比拉高，颜色偏暖、偏红，边缘色散，暗角收紧。

BGM：同一条曲子收干，房间声大过失真，低音稳住，像人还坐在馆里。
相机：抖动很轻，视野固定在 60，转向变慢，一句镜头拉得很长。
后处理：略微变锐，对比和饱和都收一点，暗角宽而淡，光晕关掉。

BGM：鼓退到很远，混响变大，只剩低频和电流。
相机：大多时候不动，偶尔猛晃一下再停住，视野收到 52。
后处理：亮度压低，对比仍在，颜色抽得很淡、偏冷，暗角很重。
